remarks: Some homes have character. Others have charm. But every once in a while, a home comes along that feels like it belongs in a storybook and this one has more character than Warner Bros. Classic! Welcome to this one-of-a-kind Craftsman-style bungalow in the heart of the Evans–Angola area, where timeless craftsmanship meets modern convenience in a home that truly feels like home from the moment you arrive. Step onto the beautiful, fully covered front porch and into a welcoming entryway featuring the original wood staircase, setting the tone for the warmth and charm found throughout. High ceilings span the entire first floor, while beautiful original woodwork adds a level of character and detail that simply cannot be replicated. Thoughtfully updated for modern living, this home offers a spacious eat-in kitchen with a center island and all appliances included, perfect for gathering with family and friends. A formal dining room and generously sized living room provide even more space to entertain, relax, and make memories. Upstairs, you’ll find three bedrooms, each featuring built-in shelving and practical closet space, along with the convenience of two full bathrooms — one on each floor. Need extra room for storage? The full basement includes laundry, with the washer and dryer included. Step outside, and the charm continues! Discover your own private retreat with a beautiful all-brick patio tucked along the side of the home, surrounded by a tall wood privacy fence — the perfect setting for morning coffee, summer evenings, or hosting friends. The fully fenced backyard extends to a wide driveway with parking for up to six vehicles, plus a two-story storage shed offering plenty of room for tools, hobbies, and outdoor equipment. And the location? It’s the best of both worlds! Enjoy convenient access to Lake Erie beaches, nearby state parks, and the outdoor recreation that makes this area so special, while Routes 5 and 20 make commuting and getting back toward the city quick and convenient.
